feeds.title: Fully Housewifed
feeds.description: Fully Housewifed includes helpful homeschool tips, book reviews, hotel reviews, restaurant reviews and tourist sights and destinations, marriage issues, family issues and parenting, tips for work at home moms and training and workshops in Manila.

feeds.title: Love. Eat. Wander
feeds.description: Love. Eat. Wander. is a travel/parenting blog about a family who believes in attachment parenting. We are parents who have surrendered mainstream practices to focus more on how to develop a strong, trusting, and healthy relationship with our child through traveling, eating, learning, and so much more!

feeds.title: Familist
feeds.description: Baby and Breakfast is a motherhood and parenthood inspirations blog committed to style, creativity, and uniqueness. We've focused on topics and content that resonate with parents, such as family life, marriage, and raising children. We also feature celebrations that are tastefully crafted by parents, as well as local vendors in the Philippines.

feeds.title: Mom On Duty Blog
feeds.description: Kimberley Reyes is a Certified OBM and Certified Asana Pro with over 10 years of experience working with digital entrepreneurs, leaders, and changemakers in the business of impacting lives through their work. Her expertise is in operations management, launch strategy and management, and team growth and management.
